system.description:
This item can be carried in hand or clipped to work equipment when not in use. Long Range.

The book gives the weight as "10" with no unit; read as 10kg.

Comm Range: All communication tools have a basic range. However, the effective range can be increased by spending +20% of the item’s cost to expand its effective range by +1.

Tech Level: Communication tools cost decrease by -20% per every tech level above the listed TL for that item, but cannot exceed three tech levels above the listed amount. The weight of the item is also halved when purchased at a higher tech level.

Comm range bands: Medium 50m, Long 250m, Very Long 500m, Distant 5km, Far 50km, Regional 500km, Continental 5,000km.
